# Week 3 guide

This week you test your assistant on purpose and improve it.

1. Write a list of at least five questions with the answer you expect for each. Save it in your
   repository as `TESTS.md`.
2. Ask the assistant every question and note which answers are wrong or weak.
3. Choose at least two weak answers, change the assistant to improve them, and ask again.

Write down what you changed and why. A fix you cannot explain is not a fix.
